desc: The new EFLX Mini Reflex Sight is EOTECH's first venture into reflex technology optics. Ideal for professional use, hunting, home defense, and more, the EFLX can be used on a variety of platforms. Designed for pistol use, the EFLX base is configured to the Leupold Delta Point Pro footprint and will adapt to appropriately milled slides or onto a rear dovetail mounting adapter. The EFLX is also ideal as a 1X solution on rifles with magnified optics. Its durable, heavy duty aluminum housing provides a large, square viewing window, similar in shape to EOTECH's HWS, that makes the 3 or 6 MOA aiming dot easy and quick to find. A top load, single 2032 battery provides roughly 20,000 hours of run time.
